scope: Disposable Microsoft 365 tenant for Outlook compatibility testing. No signup, purchase, or real-account access performed.
accountBoundary: User confirmed outlook.live.com is disposable test account; outlook.office365.com is real account and remains outside experiment scope.
recommendation: Microsoft 365 Business Basic 30-day trial in a brand-new tenant. Includes business mailbox and web Outlook; use provided onmicrosoft.com domain for initial existing-session test. Create a licensed non-admin test user. Do not add a subscription to the real employer tenant.
billing: Credit card required. Trial automatically converts to paid subscription; Microsoft Learn states annual term by default. Turn off recurring billing in Billing > Your products before expiry; official docs say trial remains until month end without charge.
freeAlternative: Microsoft 365 E5 developer sandbox is free only for eligible members, including qualifying Visual Studio Professional/Enterprise subscribers and qualifying partner/support customers; not universally available to all developers. Includes Exchange Online and test users.
limits: Trial tenant does not reproduce real employer policies or supply Okta federation automatically. It enables initial Outlook Case 2 investigation, not proof of Okta-backed Case 1 or real-tenant compatibility.
